name: Bun ca cay
summary: Bún cá cay is a morning bowl of rice noodles and fish in a light broth with a chili note. A full bowl has close to ten toppings from the fish, including offal and fish maw, plus banana blossom and dọc mùng.
origin: Hai Phong. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, 24 July 2023.
taste: Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng calls the broth light, with a chili note.
howToEat: Eat it as a morning bowl.
